animal placed high on the shaft of a broad, T-topped upright slab

justification: Both surfaces show a single schematic quadruped with an elongated muzzle, strongly arched back and sharply angled, stepped legs, carved in shallow relief high on the shaft of a broad flat upright with an overhanging horizontal top, with the rest of the surface left blank. The only notable differences in depicted content are the direction the creature faces and slight variation in how the limbs are broken into angular segments, which is trivial beside the shared motif and placement.
